Liquidity is the unrestricted cash and cash equivalents of the Parent and its consolidated Subsidiaries.","concepts":["liquidity_covenant","financial_covenant"]},{"name":"Maximum leverage covenant","found":true,"value":"6.00 to 1.00","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 6.12(b)","quote":"The Leverage Ratio at the end of each fiscal quarter of the Parent does not exceed 6.00 to 1.00.","note":"Tested at the end of each fiscal quarter of the Parent. The Subordinated Debt add-back in Section 6.12(c) does not apply to this covenant.","concepts":["tangible_net_worth_covenant","financial_covenant"]},{"name":"Delinquency trigger","found":true,"value":"Three-period average Delinquency Ratio exceeds 6.0%","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 7.1","quote":"if the average of the Delinquency Ratio for the three most recently ended Collection Periods exceeds 6.0%","note":"Delinquency Ratio (Section 1.1) is the Outstanding Balance of Pool Receivables 60 or more days past due, divided by all Pool Receivables, excluding charged-off Defaulted Receivables. A Collection Period is a calendar month. While the trigger continues, the Revolving Period is suspended and no further Advances need be made. The lender's 5% 60+ day delinquency alert is a separate monitoring threshold, not the contractual trigger.","concepts":["delinquency_trigger","trigger","days_past_due"]},{"name":"Reserve amount","found":true,"value":"1% of Eligible Pool Balance","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 1.1 (definition of Reserve Amount)","quote":"\"Reserve Amount\" means, on any date, an amount equal to 1% of the Eligible Pool Balance.","note":"The Reserve Amount is measured against the Eligible Pool Balance before any deduction of the Excess Concentration Amount (definition of Eligible Pool Balance). It is deducted after the Advance Rate is applied (definition of Borrowing Base, clause (c)).","concepts":["reserve","eligible_pool","borrowing_base"]},{"name":"Excess concentration treatment","found":true,"value":"Deducted from Eligible Pool Balance before Advance Rate","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 1.1 (definitions of Borrowing Base and Excess Concentration Amount)","quote":"(a) the Eligible Pool Balance less the Excess Concentration Amount, multiplied by (b) the Advance Rate then in effect","note":"The Schedule 2 percentages are measured against the Eligible Pool Balance before the Excess Concentration Amount is deducted. Limits are applied in the order listed in Schedule 2, and an amount excluded under one limit is not counted again under a later limit.","concepts":["excess_concentration","concentration_limit","eligible_pool","advance_rate","borrowing_base"]},{"name":"Concentration limits","found":true,"value":"4","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Schedule 2","quote":"Receivables secured by used Financed Vehicles","note":"Schedule 2 lists four limits: single state 20%, single Dealer 5%, original term over 72 months 25%, and used Financed Vehicles 70%. Amendment No. 1 adds a row 5 (FICO below 600: 35%) from 1 March 2026; this is not applied here.","concepts":["concentration_limit","eligible_pool","excess_concentration"]},{"name":"Eligibility criteria","found":true,"value":"12","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Schedule 1","quote":"12. Unique collateral.","note":"Schedule 1 lists twelve numbered criteria. A Receivable that fails any one of them is excluded in full (definition of Eligible Receivable). Criterion 7 relies on Schedule 4, which is not in the pack.","concepts":["eligibility_criterion","receivable","eligible_pool"]},{"name":"Advance rate","found":true,"value":"85%","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 2.3","quote":"The \"Advance Rate\" means 85%.","note":"This is the unamended position.
